Scope and player interaction

Choose resources randomly from intentionally authored eligible sites, not arbitrary map coordinates. Server selection respects biome, surface, navigation, collision, roads, quotas and active/depleted generations, and can be reproduced from recorded zone seed/cycle.

StageMeaning
First integration: Phase12committed; full feature contract may include explicitly staged later extensions
EvidenceAuthored implementation specification; no native/Blueprint/backend runtime verified

UI state machine

CatalogLoading → SelectingSites → Active → Depleted → RespawnDue → PlacementRejected → Degraded

WBP_Diagnostics observes results from URPGResourceDirector. Pending is not Accepted. Close/cancel clears local focus and stale callbacks, but cannot undo an already committed backend command.

Definitions, fields and units

Canonical definition: DA_ResourceRule_Rillmere. Stable IDs, quantities, seconds and centimeters are validated by the owner, not inferred from translated labels or sprites.

Field / rule
ResourceSiteId: unique stable authored ID with zone, resource family and candidate transform
Eligibility: biome tags, slope limit, collision footprint, road/portal clearance, water exclusion
SpawnSeed and CycleId: server-controlled audit values; resource placement seed is not loot RNG seed
ActiveQuota and MinSpacingCm: per biome/resource category
NodeGeneration: durable per site; only current active generation can be claimed
RespawnAtUtc: committed depletion time plus approved respawn interval
WorldEpoch/ZoneInstanceId: namespace for authored/shared versus instance-local resource facts

C++ / Blueprint / backend ownership

LayerResponsibility
URPGResourceDirectorImplement the native validated request/state lifecycle described below; native runtime state is not editable by UMG.
Blueprint/Data AssetsTune the declared defaults and visual/asset assignments. Keep definition references EditDefaultsOnly/BlueprintReadOnly; cosmetic hooks cannot grant rewards.
Zone serverValidate live actor ownership, range/LOS, alive/action state, cooldown/tool/target rules and current session epoch where relevant.
BackendFor durable changes, revalidate trusted catalog/revision/ownership and commit records/source claims/receipt atomically. Read-only/cosmetic features have no durable mutation.
WBP_DiagnosticsLocal observer/requester. Create only for local player; bind once, refresh immediately, unbind on teardown.

Custom command contracts

These names are project custom APIs or backend proposals, not existing Unreal/PaperZD nodes. Economic/backend requests are asynchronous; Pending resolves through the same command ID. Pure local queries are synchronous unless noted.

Command / result
ValidateCandidateSite(SiteId) -> Eligible|BadSlope|Blocked|RoadClearance|WrongBiome
SelectActiveSites(Seed, Cycle, Quotas) -> SelectedSiteIds; server deterministic selection
SpawnNode(SiteId, Generation) -> NodeActor|AlreadyActive
ReconcileResourceState(ZoneId) -> Ready|BackendUnavailable
MarkRespawnDue(SiteId, ExpectedGeneration) -> NewGeneration|NotDue

End-to-end command and observation flow

  1. Content author marks candidate sites and resource tags; an Editor validator rejects duplicate IDs, unreachable positions and invalid footprint/road intersections.
  2. On server zone startup, load durable site generations/depletion first, then choose eligible inactive candidates using the recorded seed/cycle and quotas.
  3. Project/sweep the candidate to the intended surface, verify slope/clearance and reserve spacing; do not project to a bridge below/above accidentally without surface identity.
  4. Spawn only approved active nodes; replicate nearby node type/generation/availability, with dormancy for unchanged nodes and explicit wake-up on depletion/respawn.
  5. Gather completion transaction changes durable node generation state alongside reward. Director consumes the committed result and schedules respawn.
  6. On restart, reconstruct depleted nodes/timers from backend and catch up bounded due respawns; never refill every site because the Actor was recreated.

Editor configuration and real consumers

  1. Create DT_ResourceSites_Rillmere with OreSite_A01, OreSite_A02, TreeSite_W03 and an intentionally invalid road site. Store transforms in cm and surface/biome tags.
  2. Create DA_ResourceRule_Rillmere with separate ore/tree quotas, rarity selection and spacing. Add BP_ResourceDirector once per zone with server-only authority.
  3. Place simple graybox rock/tree meshes authored or separately licensed by the developer; no such meshes are claimed to be in the sprite ZIP.
  4. Add footprint overlap checks and navigation/ground trace validation. Export validation diagnostics with exact rejected site ID and reason.
  5. Reopen zone startup readiness: resource interactions remain disabled until state reconciliation finishes. Reopen node replication settings to notify late joiners of correct depleted state.

Reopen Phase12 integration entries after creating the assets. Test fixture: L_Rillmere / OreSite_A01 / TreeSite_W03 / InvalidSite_Road. No later-phase runtime dependency should be activated before its recorded integration phase.

Failure, contention and recovery acceptance

Test stimulus and expected result
Candidate sits in road, steep cliff or blocking prop -> PlacementRejected with no node.
Two directors accidentally configured -> duplicate zone owner validation fails; do not double quotas.
Server restart after depletion -> same depleted generation and due time, not a fresh grant.
Seed/cycle replay against same catalog -> same selected site set; catalog changes require new version/audit.
Backend unavailable -> no new depletion/reward operations; display degraded state, not client-side gathering fallback.

Repeat the success route with two clients when networking exists, then disconnect immediately before/after a committed result. Query the same command and compare authoritative snapshot/receipt with UI. Restart the relevant zone, reject stale epochs, and rerun the previous phase route. Pure visual/input features instead verify cleanup and unchanged server facts. These are future test recipes, not reported passes.

Tuning, accessibility and observability

Prototype Rillmere: 12 eligible ore sites, 24 tree sites, quotas 4 ore/8 trees, minimum spacing 800 cm, road clearance 250 cm, slope <=30°. These are density test proposals; actual production catalogs are not supplied.

Metrics: eligible/rejected sites by reason, active density, resource acquisition per travel minute, contention and respawn latency. Never disclose a secret loot RNG seed in public diagnostics.

Art gaps, production and do-not-build-yet

The asset ZIP and installed PaperZD APIs remain unverified. Required new art/unsupported layer combinations are tracked in art/animation-matrix.html and art/equipment-visual-matrix.html. A legal debug visual can prove authority but is not finished content. Production features listed as later/optional remain disabled until their phase/gate passes.
